Rubric Item Group

Source: R/template-classes.R
markermd_rubric_group.Rd

S7 class representing a named group of rubric items within a question whose combined points are bounded together. A group has an optional floor (the lowest its members' combined points can go; in deduction mode, a cap on the total deduction) and an optional ceiling (the highest they can go; in additive mode, a cap on the points earned). Requiring floor <= 0 <= ceiling means a group with no selected items always contributes exactly zero. An exclusive group allows at most one of its items to be selected (severity tiers). Items reference their group through the group property of markermd_rubric_item.

Usage

markermd_rubric_group(
  label = character(0),
  floor = NA_real_,
  ceiling = NA_real_,
  exclusive = FALSE
)

Arguments

label

Character. Group name, unique within its question. Shown to the grader, and to students only when export_comments() is asked for group headings.

floor

Numeric. Lower bound on the group's combined points (<= 0), or NA for none.

ceiling

Numeric. Upper bound on the group's combined points (>= 0), or NA for none.

exclusive

Logical. Whether at most one item of the group can be selected at a time.

Value

A markermd_rubric_group S7 object.

See also

markermd_rubric_item
